entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network needs to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the Extended protocol configuration options IE in messages to transmit protocol data to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The user equipment that receives protocol data via the Extended protocol configuration options IE from the network.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission
entities.description: The process of transmitting configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE using the Extended protocol configuration options IE.

relations.description: The network includes the Extended protocol configuration options IE in messages when it needs to transmit protocol data to the UE.
The Extended protocol configuration options IE enables the transmission of protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE.
Protocol data transmission via the Extended protocol configuration options IE delivers data from the network to the UE.
